SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, c.c_salutation, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, ss.ss_ticket_number, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM store_sales AS ss
INNER JOIN date_dim AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN store AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics AS hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer AS c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE d.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
  AND d.d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
  AND s.s_county = 'Williamson County'
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential IN ('1001-5000', '5001-10000')
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
  AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 2 * hd.hd_vehicle_count
GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk, c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, c.c_salutation, c.c_preferred_cust_flag
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC
